title: Proportional verification: effort scales with blast radius
subject: proportional-verification
ratio: Verification effort scales with blast radius. Doc and scratch tasks get a brief replay; control-plane and contract tasks get full adversarial replay. Do not spend 20 tool calls verifying a README, and do not brief-replay a change that can break the control plane.
